messages:
ivy (product): Brain dump: can we make the operator ack flow for automatic fallbacks super compact? Ops want <3 clicks.

omar (eng-platform): Yes. proposal: inbox card + small modal. Buttons: Preview, Dry-run (sample %), Activate, Override. Preview shows 3 samples only.

trina (sre): Important: every activation must emit decision_id, policy_hash, trigger_snapshot. Also include affected_routes list.

lee (ops): UX: show a one-liner "why" (metric + delta) and a tiny link to traces. Also allow a short note on ack.

omar (eng-platform): Implementation: immutable decision objects. Activate returns {decision_id,status,preview_url}. Runtime accepts X-Decision-Id header for trace correlation.

ivy (product): Modes we expose: observe (sample), partial (percent traffic), strict (all traffic). Keep naming simple.

trina (sre): Add metric: fallback_decisions_total{mode,trigger}. Gauge for active_fallbacks_by_route. Also record outcome: success/fail/rollback.

lee (ops): Race condition: two operators click activate. Plan: second click creates override decision referencing original. Show both in timeline.

omar (eng-platform): Good. Also we will store preview snapshots in object store with policy_version pointer. Scrub PII before storing.

ivy (product): Edge: policy edited after preview. Show policy version diff in modal and warn before activate.

ci-bot: build-bot: PR #3482 (feature/compact-ackflow) passed unit tests and deployed to staging at 2026-03-25T11:02:03Z

omar (eng-platform): Action items: I'll open API PR for header + activation payload. lee will mock inbox UI. trina will wire metrics. ivy will draft microcopy.

ivy (product): Thanks — aim for a short spec + example event by EOD tomorrow.
